name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding dumbbells. Pull the weights up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Think about driving your elbows toward the ceiling and squeezing a pencil between your shoulder blades at the top.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back, using momentum to swing the weights, not pulling high enough.
modification: Use a bench for support with one-arm rows.
low_impact_alternative: Supported single-arm dumbbell row on a bench.
advanced_progression: Increase weight or add a pause at the top of each rep.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a bench for support, holding a dumbbell in the other hand. Pull the weight up to your ribcage, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Keep your hips level — resist the urge to rotate your torso as you pull.
common_mistakes: Rotating the torso, jerking the weight, hunching the supporting shoulder.
modification: Use a lighter weight or place both knees on the floor with hand on a low bench.
advanced_progression: Slow tempo (3-second lower) or heavier weight.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band at shoulder height with arms extended forward, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together until the band touches your chest.
coaching_cue: Keep arms straight and move only at the shoulders. Squeeze and hold for a count at the widest point.
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows, shrugging the shoulders, using a band that's too heavy.
modification: Use a lighter band or widen your grip.
advanced_progression: Use a heavier band or hold the squeeze for 3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward. Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and avoid swinging. Control the way down.
common_mistakes: Using body momentum, elbows drifting forward, going too fast on the lowering phase.
modification: Seated bicep curls to prevent swaying.
advanced_progression: Hammer curls or slow tempo (4-second lower).

name: Resistance Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band overhead (door anchor or pull-up bar). Kneel or stand and pull the band down to your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
coaching_cue: Drive your elbows down and back, as if putting them in your back pockets.
common_mistakes: Leaning too far back, pulling with the arms only instead of engaging the back.
modification: Use a lighter band and focus on the mind-muscle connection.
low_impact_alternative: Seated version of the same exercise.
advanced_progression: Use a heavier band or add a 2-second hold at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding light dumbbells. Raise the weights out to the sides until arms are parallel to the floor, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Lead with your pinkies slightly and focus on squeezing between your shoulder blades.
common_mistakes: Using too-heavy weights, swinging the body, rounding the back.
modification: Perform seated on the edge of a bench to reduce balance demand.
advanced_progression: Add a 2-second hold at the top of each rep.
